title: Hearing is Believing? Evaluating and Analyzing Audio Language Model Sycophancy with SYAUDIO
benchmark_measurement: The paper measures sycophancy in Audio Language Models across several domains, including ethical judgment. The ethical judgment component is sourced from the moral subset of the MMLU benchmark. This does not explicitly measure faith or religion, but may implicitly include scenarios involving moral or ethical stances related to religious beliefs.
findings: No specific findings related to religion were reported, as the paper's focus was on the general phenomenon of sycophancy. The ethical judgment task, which used the MMLU dataset, showed varying levels of sycophancy across different models and scenarios, but these results were not analyzed from a religious perspective.
